Functions $g$ and $h$ are graphed.

![Function g is graphed. The x-axis goes from negative 4 to 4. The graph consists of a set of line segments and a closed circle. The set starts at (negative 4, 1), moves upward to an open circle at (negative 2, 5), moves downward to (0, 3), moves upward to (2, 5), moves downward and ends at (4, 1). The closed circle is plotted at (negative 2, 1).](web+graphie:${☣ LOCALPATH}/images/c5eb716ddd3efd56d434fbd5c4d4934e087982fe) ![Function h is graphed. The x-axis goes from negative 4 to 4. The graph consists of a set of line segments. The set starts at (negative 4, 5), moves downward though (negative 2, 1) to (0, negative 1), moves horizontally to the right to (2, negative 1), moves upward and ends at (4, 3).](web+graphie:${☣ LOCALPATH}/images/1788d6f53b2b09511682711395d04e983f5df5cc)

**Find $\displaystyle\lim_{x\to -2}\dfrac{g(x)}{h(x)}$.**

[[☃ radio 1]]
